stem_book: Three particles are fixed on a ring of mass 4m and radius R rolling without slipping on the ground with centre speed v, as shown in figure: a particle m at each end of the horizontal diameter and a particle 2m at the lowest point of the ring. Find the kinetic energy of the system.
reason: Coordinator: print gives no speed; a speed had to be invented - not used. print gives no speed symbol; centre speed v and pure rolling stated explicitly (printed answer key has no entry for Q2)
work: ring (1/2)(4m)v²·2 = 4mv²; side particles speed √2v ⇒ 2·(1/2)m(2v²) = 2mv²; bottom 2m at rest ⇒ 6mv²
